title: Great Power Brings Great Responsibility: Personalizing Conversational AI for Diverse Problem-Solvers

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing ChatGPT responses to coding queries using standard prompting versus persona-based prompt engineering based on the GenderMag framework, which utilizes personas (Abi and Tim) to represent problem-solving styles that cluster by gender.

Qualitative evaluation of how conversational AI models can adapt to diverse learning and problem-solving styles (e.g., process-oriented and risk-averse vs. exploratory and experimental) by tailoring prompts to specific cognitive personas.
